This package models PyFlyt/QuadX-Hover-v4 only; the other card entry symbols (waypoints, gates, pole balance, pole waypoints) are sibling environments and are not covered. PyFlyt, pybullet, numpy and gymnasium were not installed or run, so the fake was never compared with the upstream simulation: it is a kinematic stand-in (fidelity F0) and its gaps name the missing rigid-body, contact, motor, sensor, wind and random-stream behaviour. The action bounds are derived by the Gymnasium bridge from the fake action space and are sourced to the clone in facts; the package declares no Limit and no operator-required bound, so there is no site-limits.example.json. No hardware was attached or run, no catalogue extension id was used, and the package is model-authored and unreviewed.
